lines.en: label beachvacation10:
scene beachbreakfast1
: ...And so I say to the guy, “You {i}can’t{/i} kick me out! My father owns the place!”
lines.zh: : ……于是我就跟那家伙说，「你{i}不能{/i}把我赶出去！这地方是我爸的！」

lines.en: : And so he’s all like, “Miss, that doesn’t mean you’re allowed to just free all of the animals! That will put them in danger!”
lines.zh: : 然后他就一副「小姐，那也不代表你可以把所有动物都放生啊！那会让它们陷入危险！」的样子。

lines.en: : So I grab him by the collar of his stupid shirt and I look him in the eyes and say...
lines.zh: : 于是我一把揪住他那件蠢衬衫的领子，盯着他的眼睛说……

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast2
: My middle name is danger...and if you’ve got a problem with me freeing a few puppies, {i}I’ve got the nerve to show you why{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我的中间名就叫危险……你要是敢对我放几只小狗有意见，{i}那我就有胆量让你见识见识为什么。{/i}

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast3
: But...that’s not your middle name. You don’t even have a middle name. You’re Japanese.
lines.zh: : 可是……那不是你的中间名啊。你连中间名都没有。你是日本人。

lines.en: : Hold the phone. Why would anyone get into trouble over freein’ some puppies? Puppies are supposed to be free!
lines.zh: : 等等。干嘛有人会因为放生小狗惹上麻烦？小狗本来就该是自由的！

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast4
: I don’t think there’s anywhere in the world, let alone Japan, where puppies are {i}supposed{/i} to roam free.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这世上任何地方——更别说日本了——都没有小狗{i}该{/i}自由乱跑的说法。

lines.en: : The vast majority of dogs, other than wild ones like wolves I mean, are domesticated.
lines.zh: : 除了狼之类的野生动物，绝大多数狗都是被驯养的。

lines.en: : So the chances of a normal puppy surviving alone in the wilderness is significantly lower than it would be should that puppy be in the care of a human.
lines.zh: : 所以一只普通小狗独自在野外活下来的概率，比有人类照料的概率要低得多。

lines.en: : ...Why do ya gotta be so {i}real{/i} all the time?
lines.zh: : ……你干嘛非得这么{i}较真{/i}啊？

lines.en: : Why can’t ya just let my innocent heart think about some happy puppies floodin’ the streets of Kumon-mi?
lines.zh: : 你就不能让我这颗纯洁的心，想象一下快乐的小狗涌上 Kumon-mi 街头的景象吗？

lines.en: : Because that would cause a multitude of problems that-
lines.zh: : 因为那会引发一大堆问题，比方说——

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast5
: So anyway, how was your night, Karin? You went out jogging, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 总之，花梨，你昨晚过得怎么样？你去跑步了对吧？

lines.en: : I think most of us were probably asleep by the time you got back, right?
lines.zh: : 我想你回来的时候，我们大部分人大概都睡了吧？

lines.en: : Oh, uhh, yeah. It was nice. I kind of forgot how much harder it is to run in the sand, so that was a little bit of a wake up call.
lines.zh: : 哦，嗯，对。挺好的。我都忘了在沙地上跑步有多费劲，算是被现实教育了一下。

lines.en: : You were able to find a spot in the room, though, right? I know it was kinda cramped in there. Especially with Molly sprawling out all over the place.
lines.zh: : 不过你在房间里找到地方睡了吧？我知道里面挺挤的。尤其是Molly摊得到处都是。

lines.en: : Yeah...I felt really bad for the one girl...Rin, I think?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我挺同情那个女生的……Rin，是吧？

lines.en: : She was basically hugging her the entire night.
lines.zh: : 她基本上一整晚都抱着人家。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast6
: Rin?! Imagine how I feel! I barely even know the girl and she was all up on me like I was her friggin’ body pillow!
lines.zh: : Rin？！那我呢！我连跟那丫头都不太熟，她就黏在我身上，把我当成她的抱枕似的！

lines.en: : I felt like I was two steps away from gettin’ married with how close we were!
lines.zh: : 我们贴得那么近，我感觉自己离结婚就差两步了！

lines.en: : You should have come slept next to me like I told you to in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你当初就该听我的，过来睡我旁边。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast7
: What, you mean right in front of the bathroom? Wouldn’t it be annoying havin’ people step over you to get in all night?
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说就在洗手间门口？整晚被人跨来跨去上厕所，不烦吗？

lines.en: : I don’t even think I woke up at all. But I’m kind of a heavy sleeper so...yeah.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我压根就没醒过。不过我睡得比较沉就是了……嗯。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast8
: I’m really thankful for that, by the way. Because I totally kicked you when I went in there to get dressed last night and you didn’t even move.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我真的很感谢。因为我昨晚进去换衣服的时候结结实实踹了你一脚，你居然一点反应都没有。

lines.en: : Gee. Thank you, beloved sister, for abusing me in my sleep. I’ll be sure to return the favor tonight.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。谢谢你，我亲爱的姐姐，在我睡着时虐待我。今晚我一定会回报你的。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to not go to sleep until really late then.
lines.zh: : 那我就确保自己今晚熬到很晚再睡。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast9
: Oh, I've been meaning to ask...What’s it like having a little sister, Karin?
lines.zh: : 哦，我一直想问……花梨，有个妹妹是什么感觉？

lines.en: : I’ve always wanted one myself but my parents have always been pretty adamant about only having one child.
lines.zh: : 我一直想要一个，可我父母一直很坚持只要一个孩子。

lines.en: : Yeah, Karin. What’s it like? Answer very carefully.
lines.zh: : 是啊，花梨。什么感觉？仔细回答哦。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast10
: Well...
: That’s kind of a hard question.
lines.zh: : 这问题有点难回答。

lines.en: : {i}Very carefully...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}非常仔细地回答……{/i}

lines.en: : Kirin and I don’t always get along. In fact, she was pretty unbearable when the two of us were little.
lines.zh: : 我和Kirin并不总是相处融洽。事实上，我们小时候她相当让人受不了。

lines.en: : Being taller and older than her meant that she got a lot of my old clothes as I grew out of them, but that never stopped her from taking the ones I still used either...
lines.zh: : 因为我比她高、比她大，我穿小的衣服就会落到她手里，可那也没能阻止她把我还在穿的衣服也拿走……

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast11
: Plus, I can’t even remember how many fights we’ve gotten into over other stupid stuff like where to go out to eat or what to name our cat.
lines.zh: : 而且我都记不清我们为了其他蠢事吵过多少次，比如去哪儿吃饭，或者给我们的猫取什么名字。

lines.en: : I won the cat battle, in case anyone is wondering.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，猫的名字那场架是我赢了。

lines.en: : I’m clearly the superior sister.
lines.zh: : 我显然才是更优秀的那个姐姐。

lines.en: : Is that really what you think? That you won?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得是自己赢了？

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast12
: Uhh...well we went with the name {i}I{/i} chose, so yeah. That counts as a victory for me.
lines.zh: : 呃……可最后用的是{i}我{/i}选的名字啊，所以没错。这算我赢了。

lines.en: : We went with {i}a{/i} name that you {i}agreed{/i} to. And you chose it out of a hat.
lines.zh: : 用的是{i}一个{/i}你「{i}同意{/i}」的名字。而且你是从帽子里抽出来的。

lines.en: : Whatever, still my name. You weren’t allowed to put anything in the hat anyway.
lines.zh: : 随便啦，反正还是我的名字。而且你本来就不许往帽子里放东西。

lines.en: : That’s just what Mom told you.
lines.zh: : 那只是妈妈骗你的。

lines.en: : The {i}real{/i} truth is that I made up all of the names in the hat and just let you pick whichever one because I liked them all.
lines.zh: : {i}真相{/i}是，帽子里的名字全都是我编的，我让你随便挑一个，因为每一个我都喜欢。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast13
: You bitch!
lines.zh: : 你这贱人！

lines.en: : You two have been lying to me for years and letting me think I named the cat, when it’s really just been one long prank?!
lines.zh: : 你们两个骗了我这么多年，让我以为猫是我取的名，结果其实从头到尾都是一个长长的恶作剧？！

lines.en: : I don’t even want the cat anymore! Take it back to the pet store!
lines.zh: : 我连猫都不要了！把它退回宠物店去！

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast14
: That pet store closed down like six years ago...
lines.zh: : 那家宠物店大概六年前就倒闭了……

lines.en: : And besides, you love Pancake. I don’t believe for a split second that you’d give him up that easily.
lines.zh: : 再说，你爱死了「松饼」。我半点都不信你会那么轻易把它送走。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast15
: Yeah well...fuck you, Karin.
lines.zh: : 是又怎样……操你的，花梨。

lines.en: : I love you too!
lines.zh: : 我也爱你！

lines.en: : Your relationship seems a little more...complicated than I imagined it would be based on how often you two are together.
lines.zh: : 你们的关系，比我想象的要……复杂一点，毕竟你们俩几乎形影不离。

lines.en: : I always figured having a little sister would be like always having someone to look after and...train, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为有个妹妹，就像是身边永远有个要照顾……还有要调教的人，大概吧。

lines.en: : Kind of like a mini-version of myself.
lines.zh: : 就像是迷你版的我自己。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast16
: Oh, heck no! I can barely deal with one of you!
lines.zh: : 哦，可别！光是你一个我就快应付不过来了！

lines.en: : Ya have any idea how hard my life would be with {i}two{/i} Makoto’s? I’d never have time for soccer anymore.
lines.zh: : 你知道要是有{i}两个{/i}Makoto，我的日子会过得有多惨吗？我以后都没时间踢球了。

lines.en: : True, but at least you’d be passing math.
lines.zh: : 说得也是，不过至少你数学能及格了。

lines.en: : What even is math?!
lines.zh: : 数学到底是个啥？！

lines.en: : It’s the subject with all of the numbers.
lines.zh: : 就是那个全是数字的科目。

lines.en: : I know what it is! But like, what the heck {i}is{/i} it?! You know?!
lines.zh: : 我知道它是什么！可它到底{i}是{/i}个啥东西？！你懂吧？！

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不懂。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast17
: Well, at the end of the day, I think it’s pretty safe to say that Kirin isn’t anything like me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说到底，我想可以很肯定地说，Kirin跟我一点都不像。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right...
lines.zh: : 这点你说对了……

lines.en: : But honestly, I can’t imagine what life would be like without her.
lines.zh: : 不过说实话，我无法想象没有她的生活会是什么样。

lines.en: : Even if we fight all of the time and even if she stole like half of my clothes when we were growing up, thinking about doing all of that without her just seems pointless.
lines.zh: : 就算我们整天吵架，就算我们小时候她偷走了我一半的衣服，可一想到没有她在身边做这些事，就觉得毫无意义。

lines.en: : It sounds dumb, I’m sure, but I love her a lot. She means the world to me and, as her big sister, I’ll always have her back no matter what.
lines.zh: : 听起来很傻，我知道，但我很爱她。她就是我的全世界，而作为她的姐姐，无论发生什么我都会站在她这边。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast18
: Sis, what the fuck?! Why are you getting all sappy all of a sudden?!
lines.zh: : 姐，你他妈搞什么？！怎么突然这么煽情？！

lines.en: : I haven’t even had breakfast yet! I don’t want to hear that!
lines.zh: : 我连早饭都还没吃呢！我不想听这些！

lines.en: : Don’t want to hear what? That I love you?
lines.zh: : 不想听什么？不想听我说我爱你？

lines.en: : Yes! You can’t just...say stuff like that in public! It’s embarrassing!
lines.zh: : 对！你不能就这么……在大庭广众之下说这种话！太难为情了！

lines.en: : I love you, Kirin!
lines.zh: : 我爱你，Kirin！

lines.en: : Ahhhhhhh!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast19
: Hey, Tsuneyo. Whatcha thinkin’ about over there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Tsuneyo。你在那儿想什么呢？

lines.en: : You’ve been pretty quiet all morning and I just want to make sure you’re not feeling left out or anything.
lines.zh: : 你一早上都很安静，我只是想确认你没有觉得被冷落什么的。

lines.en: : Yeah. We’re all friends here. Tell us what’s on your mind.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们在这儿都是朋友。说说你在想什么吧。

lines.en: : Masturbation.
lines.zh: : 自慰。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast20
scene beachbreakfast21
: Did I say something wrong?
lines.zh: : 我说错什么了吗？

lines.en: : Well...no!
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有！

lines.en: : I mean, I’m sure we all...everyone once in a while, but...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我们肯定都……偶尔会，可是……

lines.en: : Breakfast isn’t really the...best time to bring something like that up.
lines.zh: : 早饭时间确实不是……提这种事的最好时机。

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : No...it’s just like...
lines.zh: : 不是……只是说……

lines.en: : You know what? Maybe you should just go back to the inn alone for a little while if you really need to...do that.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？你要是真的那么想……做那件事，也许该先一个人回旅馆待一会儿。

lines.en: : Do what?
lines.zh: : 做什么？

lines.en: : Masturbate, obviously.
lines.zh: : 自慰啊，显然。

lines.en: : But I don’t know how.
lines.zh: : 可我不知道该怎么做。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast22
: What?...
: I don’t know what masturbation is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自慰是什么。

lines.en: : I heard our teacher use the word yesterday and he told me it would be best to ask all of you about it.
lines.zh: : 我昨天听到老师用了这个词，他告诉我说最好来问问你们。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast23
: Pfft...
: That son of a bitch.
lines.zh: : 那个狗娘养的。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast24
: Would you...maybe mind explaining why Sensei would have told you to ask us about something like that?
lines.zh: : 你……介意解释一下，Sensei为什么会让你来问我们这种事吗？

lines.en: : He said that it was something that he probably shouldn’t teach me about and that one of you would show me.
lines.zh: : 他说这种事大概不该由他来教我，还说你们中会有人给我示范。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast23
: That son of a bitch...
lines.zh: : 那个狗娘养的……

lines.en: : HAHAHAH! OH MY GOD!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！我的天哪！

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast24
: Well, uhh...I guess the easiest way to explain it would be that it’s like...sex that you do to yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃……最简单的解释大概是，就像是……自己对自己做的性行为。

lines.en: : With like, your fingers or...toys or...the corner of the boy you admire’s desk.
lines.zh: : 用，比如说，手指或者……道具或者……你暗恋的男生桌子的桌角。

lines.en: : Pretty much anything can get the job done if you try hard enough.
lines.zh: : 只要你肯下功夫，基本上什么都能派上用场。

lines.en: : Is...anyone else getting dizzy?
lines.zh: : 有……有没有别人觉得头晕？

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : So it is sex that you do to yourself.
lines.zh: : 所以就是自己对自己做的性行为。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好的。

lines.en: : Great, so I guess we can just-
lines.zh: : 太好了，那我想我们可以就——

lines.en: : What is sex?
lines.zh: : 什么是性行为？

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast25
: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAH!!!! AHHHHHH!!!!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！！啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: : Ahh! Karin died! Someone call an ambulance!
lines.zh: : 啊！花梨死了！快叫救护车！

lines.en: : She’s not dead, Miku. She just...needs a minute to recover, I think.
lines.zh: : 她没死，Miku。她只是……需要点时间缓缓，我觉得。

lines.en: : Is the tall girl with the beautiful abs going to be okay?
lines.zh: : 那个腹肌很漂亮的高个子女生会没事吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...She’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她会没事的。

lines.en: : You’re the one I’m worried about.
lines.zh: : 我担心的是你。

lines.en: scene beachbreakfast26
: I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。

lines.en: : I know you don’t...
lines.zh: : 我知道你不明白……

lines.en: : How about the two of us have a conversation in private later, okay?
lines.zh: : 要不我们俩待会儿私下聊聊，好吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to teach me how to sex?
lines.zh: : 你要教我怎么做爱吗？

lines.en: : Let’s just...
lines.zh: : 我们就……

lines.en: : Sure. Yeah. I’ll teach you how to sex.
lines.zh: : 好吧。行。我会教你怎么做爱。

lines.en: scene sky
: So, what are you planning on doing today, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那么，Ami，你今天打算做什么？

lines.en: : Me? I don’t know. More vacation stuff probably.
lines.zh: : 我？不知道。大概还是度假那些事吧。

lines.en: : I know Ayane and some of the other girls are eating breakfast right now, but I can’t imagine they’re talking about anything exciting.
lines.zh: : 我知道Ayane和其他几个女生正在吃早饭，不过我想她们也聊不出什么有意思的东西。

lines.en: : Well let’s hope you didn’t miss anything fun.
lines.zh: : 那就希望你没有错过什么好玩的事吧。

lines.en: Ami and I make it to the beach a short while later to find Karin passed out on her plate of breakfast.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，我和Ami来到海滩，发现花梨趴在她那盘早餐上昏睡过去。

lines.en: I guess she must have had a long night.
lines.zh: 看来她昨晚肯定很辛苦。

lines.en: scene black
I decide to get some food from a nearby stall and scarf down an omelette before setting off to find something else to do this morning.
lines.zh: 我决定去附近的小摊买点吃的，狼吞虎咽地解决掉一份煎蛋卷，然后出发去找今天早上别的事做。
